sources.name: szse-2006-rules.html
sources.title: 关于发布《深圳证券交易所交易规则》的通知
relevant_passages_limited: 2.2.1 下列证券可以在本所市场挂牌交易：…基金
2.3.1 本所交易日为每周一至周五。国家法定假日和本所公告的休市日，本所市场休市。
发布通知：2006-05-15；自2006年7月1日起施行；11.6 修改时亦同。
typed_facts: 2.2.1 explicitly lists funds as exchange-traded security category
2.3.1 states exchange trading days are Monday through Friday; statutory holidays and exchange-announced closures are closed
Notice page says publication 2006-05-15 and rule effective 2006-07-01; 11.6 says amendments also require approval
sources.2017_applicability: 2006 rule version effective from 2006-07-01; this saved page alone does not establish that clause 2.3.1 remained unmodified and applicable on 2017-01-01

sources.name: szse-2014-sell-lots.html
sources.title: 关于严格执行证券竞价交易卖出申报数量有关规定的通知
relevant_passages_limited: 卖出申报数量应当符合《交易规则》第3.3.8条及第3.3.9条。
typed_facts: 2014-07-25 official notice concerns 100-share/unit sell-order quantities and cites Trading Rules 3.3.8/3.3.9
No Monday-Friday or weekend-closure clause in this notice; citation of other clauses cannot bridge 2006 rule version to 2017
sources.2017_applicability: 2014 notice only; no proof of 2017 version of 2.3.1

No publication/effective timestamp found in saved FAQ body and no Monday-Friday calendar rule

typed_reusable_source_fact: Under the expressly saved SZSE 2006 Trading Rules version effective 2006-07-01, clause 2.3.1 defines exchange trading days as Monday through Friday and lists statutory/exchange-announced closures; funds are an eligible product class under 2.2.1. Therefore Sunday is outside that version’s ordinary planned trading week.
reason: The 2006 notice fixes its initial effective date, not an uninterrupted 2017 version. The 2014 SZSE sell-lots notice cites different order-size clauses and says nothing about clause 2.3.1 or 2017. No saved 2017-effective amendment chain was reviewed or supplied in this bounded task.
sse_limited_finding: The saved SSE 2012/2013 amendment is about price limits and the saved undated ETF FAQ is about T+1/100 units; neither states ordinary Monday-Friday trading days or proves a complete 2017 SSE calendar. Do not promote them to planned opening calendar evidence.
jan2017_effect: May add a typed, historical-version-conditional ordinary-week-rule fact only. Does not qualify 2017-01-01 planned closure under a proven 2017-effective version, does not recover the missing retrospective SZSE jybz, and does not change original January notice question bounded-unproven result or 43/44 months status.
